Response fields include usage.input_tokens, usage.output_tokens, usage.total_tokens, usage.input_tokens_details.cached_tokens, and usage.output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens.

Session caching reports usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, usage.x_details.prompt_tokens_details.cache_creation_input_tokens, and usage.x_details.prompt_tokens_details.cache_creation.ephemeral_5m_input_tokens. Cache creation fields are absent when no new cache is created.

Each x_details entry with x_billing_type=response_api contains usage.x_details.input_tokens, usage.x_details.output_tokens, usage.x_details.input_tokens_details.text_tokens, usage.x_details.input_tokens_details.image_tokens, usage.x_details.output_tokens_details.text_tokens, and usage.x_details.output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens.

The response.completed stream event carries response.usage. Tool counters include usage.x_tools.web_search.count, usage.x_tools.image_search.count, and usage.x_tools.web_search_image.count.
